meta.title: VoiceBridge - Your Voice, Any Cursor
meta.description: Use your phone as a voice input remote for macOS and Windows. Record once, choose a screen, and send text straight to the active cursor.

og.title: VoiceBridge - Your Voice, Any Cursor
og.description: Use your phone as a voice input remote for macOS and Windows. Record once, choose a screen, and send text straight to the active cursor.

hero.sr_subtitle: Speak on your phone and send the transcribed text straight to the active cursor on any connected computer.
typewriter: Speak on your phone. Text lands at your cursor.
Save long text. Send it again with one tap.
hero.media_alt: VoiceBridge on a phone beside a laptop, with an orange voice stream flowing toward the active cursor.
hero.slide1_alt: VoiceBridge on a phone beside a laptop, with an orange voice stream flowing toward the active cursor.
hero.slide2_alt: A phone sending voice input to active cursors across a browser, code editor, and document on multiple computers.
hero.slide3_alt: Before and after scene showing VoiceBridge freeing a user from typing at the keyboard.
hero.slide4_alt: A developer dictates a rate limit change from a phone while VoiceBridge sends the text to the active cursor in a code editor.

product.title: Speak once. Keep your flow.
product.lead: Record on your phone. VoiceBridge transcribes and sends text to the computer you choose.
product.main_body: Choose the active computer, speak, and keep working. Your text arrives at the cursor without pulling you into another window.
product.media_alt: A phone sending voice input to active cursors across a browser, code editor, and document on multiple computers.
product.aux1_body: Sign in on your computers with the same account. Your phone finds every online device, ready for you to choose and send.
product.aux2_body: If auto-paste is unavailable, your text still reaches the computer clipboard, ready to paste.

showcase.aria_label: Voice input without being tied to a keyboard
showcase.image_alt: Before and after scene showing VoiceBridge freeing a user from typing at the keyboard. The image reads: Your ideas shouldn't be tied to a keyboard.
showcase.caption: Capture the idea while it is fresh. Keep your computer focused on the work.

commands.title: Save it once. Send it in seconds.
commands.lead: Turn repeatable text into commands, then send the full version to your active cursor with one tap.

developer.image_alt: A developer dictates a rate limit change from a phone while VoiceBridge sends the text to the active cursor in a code editor. The image reads: Lean back. Keep coding.
developer.caption: Developer flow, uninterrupted. Dictate prompts, review notes, and code changes while your editor stays active.

how.title: Phone to cursor in 3 steps
how.step1_body: Visit on your phone's browser. Sign up or log in.
how.step2_body: Sign in with the same account. Connect multiple computers.
how.step3_body: Choose a computer on your phone, tap to record, and text lands right at that cursor.

pricing.title: Simple, usage-based pricing
pricing.lead: Start free. Upgrade when you need more.

download.title: Bring VoiceBridge to your computer
download.lead: Available for macOS and Windows. Install it on every computer you use.
download.free_note: Free plan available. No credit card required.
